item.title: Lawler disagrees with Trump on Iran war: 'It is certainly not small potatoes'
item.description:

The regime sponsored terrorism, armed proxies, threatened international shipping and targeted U.S. forces while exploiting American fears of "escalation." President Donald Trump has begun to reverse that equation.
